prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered golden blonde hair — wearing nothing but a glossy red patent-latex micro bikini: a tiny halter top with a deep plunging front held by a neck tie, and an ultra micro bikini bottom tied with thin side strings, every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, plain bare real skin. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The outfit sits on her skin with soft highlights, her skin tone running naturally everywhere else. Pose: standing front-facing with her weight on one leg, one hand resting on her outer hip and the other arm hanging relaxed, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme siren bust hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in white lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: the Banpo Bridge in Seoul at night with the glowing city skyline and a long row of lit bridge lamps behind; she stands in the middle of the road on the asphalt, car headlights and taillights streaking as long glowing white and red light trails in smooth curves on both sides of her, a deep dark-blue night sky behind her, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by the bridge lights and the glow of the light trails with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot as a long-exposure photograph taken from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height on a tripod, glowing white and red car light trails streaking in long smooth lines across the road around her while she stands perfectly sharp and still in the middle, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the lane markings, a roadside barrier and street lamps around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8 with a 2-second exposure, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
